Raise MediaTimeoutError when this thread's operation deadline has passed. Source   Edit   
proc cleanPreparedCache(cacheDir, manifestDir: string): PreparedCleanup {.
    ...raises: [IOError, OSError, JsonParsingError, ValueError], tags: [
    ReadDirEffect, ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect, TimeEffect, WriteDirEffect],
    forbids: [].}
Delete unreferenced prepared entries after a successful apply or preview.
Every *.json file directly in manifestDir is a retained manifest; all
content keys they reference are kept. Only real directories in cacheDir
named by a content key, unreferenced and unmodified for
PreparedGraceSeconds are removed; symlinks, files, work directories and
other names are ignored. Raises before deleting anything when manifestDir
is missing, holds no manifest or holds unreadable JSON. Failures removing
individual entries are collected in errors while the rest continue. Call
it from the worker that serializes preparations.
Source   Edit

proc prepareButtonMedia(config: JsonNode; configDir, cacheDir, fontPath: string;
                        timeoutMs = OperationTimeoutMs;
                        maxPreparedBytes = MaxPreparedBytes): JsonNode {....raises: [
    ValueError, MediaError, KeyError, ValueError, OSError, MediaTimeoutError,
    IOError, JsonParsingError, Exception], tags: [TimeEffect, ReadDirEffect,
    WriteDirEffect, ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect, ExecIOEffect, ReadEnvEffect,
    RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Render every non-builtin Deck key of every menu and return the manifest {"version":1,"menus":{id:{"1".."15": entry}}}. Entries are either {"builtinNumber":n} or {"normal":{"path","durationMs"},"pressed":path} with absolute JPEG paths under cacheDir. OBS-bound entries add "obsOperation" and, for mapped visual states, "states":{state:{normal, pressed}}. Every variant counts toward maxPreparedBytes. The whole preparation, including every child process, shares one timeoutMs deadline and raises MediaTimeoutError when it runs out. Preparation never deletes published cache entries, so files referenced by the running config stay valid. Source   Edit

                        WriteIOEffect, ReadIOEffect], forbids: [].}

proc runTool(args: seq[string]; timeoutMs = ChildTimeoutMs;
             maxStdout = MaxChildStdoutBytes; maxStderr = MaxChildStderrBytes): string {....raises: [
    MediaTimeoutError, OSError, IOError, OSError, ValueError, IOError],
    tags: [TimeEffect, ExecIOEffect, ReadEnvEffect, RootEffect, WriteIOEffect],
    forbids: [].}
Run a command without a shell and return its stdout. Stderr is kept separately for the error message. The child is killed when it exceeds timeoutMs, the remaining operation deadline or either output cap; both timeouts raise MediaTimeoutError. Completion is decided by process exit rather than pipe EOF, because pipes may be inherited by unrelated children spawned on other daemon threads. Source   Edit   
proc selectFrames(durationsMs: seq[int]; field = ""): seq[FrameTiming] {.

Pick displayed frames so playback never exceeds MaxFramesPerSecond. Frames starting too soon after the previous displayed frame are merged into it. A single displayed frame is static and has duration 0. Source   Edit
